Build a rectangular room outline for scene plots

Source: R/room.R
room_rect.Rd

Returns a closed polyline in the format accepted by the walls argument of plot_scene() and plot_trajectories(): columns x, y, group and type. Combine several with rbind() and add openings with opening().

Usage

room_rect(x0, y0, width, depth, id = "room")

Arguments

x0, y0

Coordinates of the south-west corner.

width, depth

Extent along x (east) and y (north).

id

Group label.

Value

A tibble with columns x, y, group, type.

Examples

walls <- rbind(room_rect(0, 0, 6, 5),
               opening(2.5, 0, 3.5, 0, type = "door"))
